bullets: Document that WinUI 3 Application has no Suspending/Resuming events (CS1061): new #lifecycle 'Suspend/Resume events are gone' subsection + 'Common build errors' entry, since UWP apps almost universally hook app suspend/resume.
Inject an inline TODO on Suspending/Resuming subscription lines via a new adaptable pattern in unsupported-api-inventory.json (anchor: lifecycle) so the agent is routed to the fix before building.
Document CS0176 for `NavigationCacheMode = NavigationCacheMode.Disabled;` (standard UWP page-template line): qualify the enum with its namespace to break the Page-property/enum name shadowing.
